_doc: Reviewed authored stair contracts for the isolated proof gate. This is not a generated measurement index. Only these contracts are allowed to drive the proof placer.

unsupportedStairs.stair_loop: composed from LVL_01_O_stairs_loop_straight_angle_L modules at 3u vertical increments (0,-3,-6,-9,-12,-15,-18,-21), which do not snap to the 2u dungeon level grid; requires a re-authored level-grid prefab or separate explicit loop contract path before placement
unsupportedStairs.straight_stair_180_L: structural stair roots still do not prove a 2u level-grid transition; current authored Stair-family roots resolve approximately to (-0.229,0,0) yaw 0 and (-3.709,1.408,0) yaw 180 in the prefab contract frame, so the second root is not level-aligned and the pair does not define exact reviewed 180-degree ports
unsupportedStairs.straight_stair_180_R: unpacked floor/stair meshes include approximately grid-shaped 180-degree geometry but with about 0.06u root drift; requires sanitized authored roots or manual reviewed contract before exact placement proof
